column2: Last time the big friend came right off. This time it will not come off, because there are no little beads to take it off with. So we take the big friend off with a small friend. Add ten first, then take the big friend using five. Two friends, one answer.
Two rods now: tens and units. Always start on the left, with the tens. Then do the units. If the units make a whole ten, that ten jumps left to the tens rod. That is a carry.
Four rods now: thousands, hundreds, tens, units. Keep your eyes moving left to right and do not lose your place. Same friends, same carries, just a longer walk.
Your turn now. Add ten first, then let the small friend finish the big friend.
Bixi is so close! The big friend will not come off by itself. Which small friend helps it off? Show Bixi.
Good catch, Bixi. Start on the left, the tens, so the carry has somewhere to land. Which rod first?
Bixi found a tricky one! When a carry lands on a rod that is already full, that rod makes a whole ten too. Which way does that ten go next?
Bixi's tens rod is overflowing. When the tens make a whole ten, a big friend carries one rod to the left. Which rod is that?
